title: WayselectCliJson
description: Versioned schema (v1) for wayselect --json machine output, dispatched on `command`: `select`/`explain` share the selection shape; `catalog import` has the import shape. Fail-closed: additionalProperties is false at every object level, so undeclared fields are rejected. Bump procedure: docs/cli-json-contract.md.

selectExplain.title: WayselectSelectExplainJson
selectExplain.description: Versioned shape (v1) for `wayselect select --json` / `wayselect explain --json` machine output. The shape is identical apart from `command`. Fail-closed: additionalProperties is false at every object level, so undeclared fields are rejected.

command.description: Which subcommand produced this output; the shape is otherwise identical.

schemaVersion.description: Machine-schema version of this payload. Only v1 is emitted; consumers pin on this marker. A shape change bumps the version (docs/cli-json-contract.md), never silently.

dryRun.description: Always true: the CLI is fixture-only, no live model calls.

dryRunLabel.description: Human-readable dry-run banner; pinned so wording changes are declared.
dryRunLabel.const: dry-run / synthetic estimate — no live model calls, credentials, or network use

status.description: Routing verdict: a route was selected, or no candidate was eligible.

selectedRouteId.description: Selected route id, or null when status is no-eligible-route.

policy.description: Selection policy; pinned so policy changes are declared.

rateDisclaimer.description: Synthetic-estimate disclaimer; pinned so wording changes are declared.
rateDisclaimer.const: Synthetic/list-price estimates only; not actual cost or savings.

provenance.description: Catalog provenance. fetchedAt is wall-clock (any valid ISO); the rest pins to the fixture.

request.description: Normalized selection request. requirements is {} when no typed requirements constrain the request.

requirements.description: Typed requirements (TOG-4794). Empty object when absent; otherwise the normalized seven-field shape.

rankedCandidates.description: All candidates, eligible first (lowest synthetic rate, then lexicographic route id), then excluded in catalog order.

catalogImport.title: WayselectCatalogImportJson
catalogImport.description: Versioned shape (v1) for `wayselect catalog import --json` machine output. Fail-closed: additionalProperties is false at every object level, so undeclared fields are rejected.

command.description: Which subcommand produced this output; const-pinned so renames are declared.

schemaVersion.description: Machine-schema version of this payload. Only v1 is emitted; consumers pin on this marker. A shape change bumps the version (docs/cli-json-contract.md), never silently.

dryRun.description: Always true: catalog import is a dry-run adapter, never a configuration step.

networkUsed.description: True only for the explicit opt-in --fetch path, which no test exercises.

source.description: Provenance source label (explicit --source, file:// input path, or fetch URL).

snapshotTimestamp.description: Provenance snapshot timestamp (explicit --snapshot-timestamp, otherwise wall-clock now).

snapshotHash.description: Canonical SHA-256 body hash of the ingested catalog mapping.

rawHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw input text as read.

providerCount.description: Providers with at least one surviving entry; the CLI fails closed on zero entries, so success is >= 1.

entryCount.description: Ingested entries; the CLI fails closed on zero, so success is >= 1.

quarantined.description: Per-entry quarantine reasons for dropped providers/models; empty when everything ingests cleanly.

outPath.description: Absolute path the catalog document was written to, or null when no --out was given.
